name: Czech University of Life Sciences Prague
summary: Prague life-sciences university on one green campus, teaching since 1906; ten English bachelor's in agriculture, forestry, environment and business.

ib.text: CZU's own recognition page says IB Diploma holders need no evaluation, so no extra fee. It asks for no IB points or subjects: each faculty admits on a Scio GAP test or an interview.

dates.label: Applications open for 2027 entry (FLD and FTZ from 14 September)

programmes.name: Agricultural Engineering
programmes.about: Three years of agricultural technology: two years of theory that lead on to technical or biological study, then applied engineering and a bachelor thesis, for farm, forestry and municipal enterprises or a technical master's.
programmes.ib: Online oral interview in maths, physics and English; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Oral interview on maths, physics, general knowledge and English, scored out of 30; 15 needed, about 15 admitted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Agriculture and Food
programmes.about: How food is made from farm to fork: agricultural practice, plant and animal biology, nutrition, soil and microbes, with food quality and technology in the last year and practicals in the university's food facilities and labs.
programmes.ib: Online Scio GAP test; the faculty sets no grade or subject requirement from your earlier schooling.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Scio GAP test; a percentile of 40 or more can be admitted, best percentile first until the 75 places are filled.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Economics, management, commercial law, accounting, psychology and business ethics, taught entirely in English, for careers in management, trade, accountancy, banking and agribusiness, or a follow-on master's.
programmes.ib: The entrance exam is Scio's online GAP test in maths and English, paid to Scio directly. No IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's online GAP test (0-100, maths and English); the committee sets a pass threshold each stage. One attempt per stage; a GAP result from 2023-26 can be uploaded.
programmes.closesNote: Five stages; the last closes 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Economics and Management
programmes.about: Economics, finance, accounting and agricultural economics, with law, statistics, operations research and informatics, for management roles in firms, services and administration or a follow-on master's.
programmes.ib: The entrance exam is Scio's online GAP test in maths and English, paid to Scio directly. No IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's online GAP test (0-100, maths and English); the committee sets a pass threshold each stage. One attempt per stage; a GAP result from 2023-26 can be uploaded.
programmes.closesNote: Five stages; the last closes 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Environmental Data Science
programmes.about: Environmental science joined to data science: GIS, programming in R and Python, machine learning, big data and hydrology, with labs, fieldwork and a thesis; compulsory courses in years one and two, electives in year three.
programmes.ib: Scio GAP test is the entrance exam; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's GAP test (0-100); the committee sets the pass threshold each phase; up to 70 admitted. A GAP result from the previous two years counts.
programmes.closesNote: A second phase runs 1 February to 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Environmental Engineering
programmes.about: Environmental protection and natural resource management: earth sciences, environmental chemistry, remediation of contaminated sites and climate-change impacts, with seminars, field workshops and year-three electives.
programmes.ib: Scio GAP test is the entrance exam; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's GAP test (0-100); the committee sets the pass threshold each phase; up to 70 admitted. A GAP result from the previous two years counts.
programmes.closesNote: A second phase runs 1 February to 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Informatics
programmes.about: An IT bachelor taught in English for work in software firms, consulting, finance and public administration, with the option of continuing to a related master's programme.
programmes.ib: The entrance exam is Scio's online GAP test in maths and English, paid to Scio directly. No IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on Scio's online GAP test (0-100, maths and English); the committee sets a pass threshold each stage. One attempt per stage; a GAP result from 2023-26 can be uploaded.
programmes.closesNote: Five stages; the last closes 31 March 2027

programmes.name: International Cooperation in Agriculture and Rural Development
programmes.about: Preparation for international technical-assistance projects in rural development: project management, intercultural communication, biology for agriculture, a personal-security course and compulsory practical training with NGOs, agencies or firms.
programmes.ib: Written World Geography and English test, waived with a school GPA of 1.6 or better on a Czech-comparable scale; ask FTZ whether IB grades qualify.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1 scores your CV (20) and school results (30), 30 needed; then a geography and English test, 45 of 100 to pass, ranked on points; up to 80 admitted.
programmes.closesNote: Stage 2 applications run 16 January to 31 March 2027

programmes.name: Sustainable Forestry and Natural Resource Management
programmes.about: Forest and non-forest ecosystems, bioeconomy and sustainable natural resource management, with economics, law, GIS, remote sensing and data analysis, and a compulsory semester abroad at a partner university in year two.
programmes.ib: Interview in English on biology, your motivation and your ability to communicate in English; no IB subject or points minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Interview in English on biology, motivation and communication; one exam date in February 2027, an alternative in June 2027.

programmes.name: Sustainable Use of Natural Resources
programmes.about: Managing the sustainable use of natural resources with soil and water at the centre and a link to food production; classes, excursions and practical training for government, consultancy or research work, or a master's.
programmes.ib: Online Scio GAP test; the faculty sets no grade or subject requirement from your earlier schooling.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Scio GAP test; a percentile of 40 or more can be admitted, best percentile first until the 60 places are filled.

notes: English-taught study is charged to EU citizens too: CZK 12,500 a year at four faculties, about CZK 13,000 at Engineering and Tropical AgriSciences; non-EU students pay CZK 25,000-80,000.

Some faculty regulations still ask for nostrification of a foreign diploma; CZU's recognition page says the IB Diploma is recognised automatically, so point the faculty to it and send the diploma at enrolment.
Each faculty runs its own application (CZK 850 each, non-refundable) and its own test: applying to two faculties means paying and testing twice.
